issue_context.title: [Blazor] Make tests culture independent
issue_context.body: Some people with other machine cultures have had trouble running our E2E tests. We should be able to set the culture on the server and likely on the browser too with Selenium with `--lang=en`

review_comments: At least for the BasicTestApp, we force the app to be en-us by default. For server app, the browser language might not make a difference (I don't think we register the localization middleware). Should we modify the apps to configure a default culture instead?

Sure, 

I notice we do have some localization in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/haok/blazor/src/Components/test/testassets/TestServer/InternationalizationStartup.cs

Should I go ahead and add it to all the various startups in TestServer only, or should I add it to all Startups under test assets?

Also so we don't want to also set it in the ChromeOptions for redundancy?
